parts.text: Leader of the Federalist Party, Mr [...] has agreed to have a private talk. Deep in your thoughts, you almost jumped when your secretary opened the door and said that Mr [...] was there.

parts.name: FPL
parts.text: Good morning, Prime Minister. To what do I owe this sudden invitation? Did you like our recent action?

options.description: I'm not sure 'like' is the appropriate word. You, and your colleagues are putting our international relations at risk for a marginal political gain! I won't tolerate it for much longer.
It depends on how you define 'like'. Do I agree with what you wanted to tell? Yes. Are such demonstrations good for our common cause? Absolutely not.
That's something I wanted to discuss. I believe you are right.

parts.name: FPL
parts.text: Threats don't work on me! For many years your government ignored our voice and did everything the Hegemon asked for. Your propaganda says we have such a close relations blabla, but the truth is we are getting economically colonised and receiving nothing meaningful in return for that. Military protection? Who exactly threatens us aside from the Matheuchellian themselves, who still occupy the Kachakonian island of Chara!

options.description: And what choice do we have? Do you really believe that pissing off the greatest empire in world's history is going to fix any problems?

You've got a point, but listen. We can't change the world immediately. There a couple of deals waiting to be sealed that require approval from Matheuchelles. That's a really bad timing on your side, with demonstrations. If you care about the country, stop your actions for a couple of months and then you are free to do whatever you like to.
Kachakonyan island? Maybe you should go and ask people out there what they think about that first? Last time I checked, 80% of Charans were happy with the current situation.

parts.name: FPL
parts.text: Not pissing off, but engaging in discussions. You are right that alone we aren't in a position to challenge Matheuchelles, but we aren't the only country in the similar spot. That's a hard pill to swallow, but we need an agreement with the Graonians.

options.description: Agreement with Graonians against the Hegemon? So it's true what they say about you. You are mad! I'm sorry, but you give me no other choice! Either you stop spreading this dangerous propaganda or we will talk differently. Pardon! Internal security agency will talk with you differently.

parts.name: FPL
parts.text: Can't wait to hear from them! I see that you are Matheuchelles' pawn like the rest of our elites and I promise you, history will remember you as such.

parts.name: FPL
parts.text: And what exactly do I stand to gain in return?

options.description: You'd better be joking. I'm not negotiating with people like you!

parts.name: FPL
parts.text: And I'm not wasting any more time talking with people like you! Thanks for the invitation, Prime Minister.

parts.name: FPL
parts.text: As I said, blackmailing doesn't work on me! Thanks for the invitation, but I don't see the point in continuing that conversation.

parts.name: FPL
parts.text: To achieve our goals, we need to awaken the Kachakonian spirit in our brothers abroad. And for that, funding is needed. The Pankachak Institute of Culture would be really grateful for some generous ministerial donations.

options.description: That's not possible. The media would explode with accusations of financially supporting extremists, not to mention relations with our partners in the region.
Consider it a done deal, but remember - no more clown fiesta on the streets for the time being.

parts.name: You
parts.text: Due to the international circumstances, I can't officially say things you do. Also, people in Kachakonya aren't ready to accept that this so-called alliance with Matheuchelles isn't beneficial for us anymore. Here is the deal. You stop attacking us, and you are allowed to do what is needed to convince people we should be more independent.
He ground the last sentence out and left the room, slamming the door in the process.
You weren't sure what to think of the guy, but at least there is one less problem to be solved...
